rule: hit when the first review by an owner, member or collaborator (not the author) after frozen_at came from one of the 3 names; pull requests closed or still unreviewed by a maintainer on the scoring day are counted apart, never as misses. Reviews between read_at and frozen_at existed before the freeze, so they are scored apart as a second, weaker read
test: primary: the suggestions' hit share with its Wilson 95% range; against the 3 busiest reviewers, McNemar's test on the pull requests where exactly one of the two lists held the reviewer
bar: met when the suggestions' lower bound is at least 65% and McNemar doesn't show the busiest reviewers doing better (p < 0.05); repo ranges (bootstrap, each repo once) reported beside it
